result:
Committed, tree clean, throwaway servers stopped. Final report follows.

## 1. Changed

- `backend/app/core/errors.py` — `assume_role_error_handler` became `client_error_handler` with a closed `AWS_ERROR_MAP` (9 AWS codes → 404/400/403/429/409 and `aws.*` codes), boto-prefix stripping (`aws_error_message`), `{aws_error_code, operation}` detail, info-level log line; unmapped codes still re-raise; assume-role check stays first; docstring rewritten.
- `backend/app/routers/memory.py`, `backend/app/routers/chat.py` — the `memory.unavailable` wrappers re-raise a mapped `ClientError` so the global handler answers 4xx instead of a 502 with raw boto text (minimal hunks only, no reformatting).
- `backend/tests/test_errors_aws.py` — new hermetic module: all 9 codes parametrized, map-coverage guard, prefix stripping (incl. nested prefix), unmapped → 500, service-level `kb.not_found` precedence, assume-role → 502.
- `backend/tests/test_errors.py` — the "left alone" case now uses `InternalServerException` (AccessDeniedException is mapped by design).
- `backend/tests/test_memory_console.py` — the 502 test uses an unmapped code; new test asserts AccessDeniedException → 403 `aws.access_denied` envelope.
- `frontend/src/locales/{en,zh-CN}/common.json` — `apiErrors.aws.not_found|validation|access_denied|throttled|conflict`.
- `frontend/src/lib/api.ts` — `localizedMessage` exported.
- `frontend/src/pages/registry/EditView.tsx` — record load error uses envelope-aware `responseMessage(res)` instead of raw `body.message`.
- `frontend/src/pages/knowledge/kb-helpers.ts` — `kbErrorMessage` prefers console copy for a known envelope code.
- `docs/api.md`, `docs/api.zh-CN.md` — error section gains the `aws.*` table + rules (message stripping, detail shape, unmapped → 500, `/v1` shares handlers).
- `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/architecture.zh-CN.md` — new section "Error envelope and AWS ClientError mapping" before "Console failure states".

## 3. Acceptance checks

- ✅ Hermetic tests in `backend/tests/test_errors_aws.py`: each mapped code → mapped status + envelope code + stripped message + `detail.aws_error_code`; `InternalServerException` → 500; AssumeRole failure → 502 `workspace.assume_role_failed`. `uv run pytest -q tests/test_errors_aws.py` passes (13 tests).
- ✅ Live read-only check from own backend on :8011 (`.claude/self-evolution/runs/SE-005/live-curl.txt`):
  ```
  GET /api/registry/records/does-not-exist
  {"code":"aws.validation","message":"1 validation error detected: Value at 'recordId' failed to satisfy constraint: …","detail":{"aws_error_code":"ValidationException","operation":"GetRegistryRecord"}} [400]
  GET /api/knowledge-bases/does-not-exist
  {"code":"aws.access_denied","message":"User: arn:aws:sts::…:assumed-role/admin_role_for_workshop/… is not authorized to perform: bedrock:GetKnowledgeBase","detail":{"aws_error_code":"AccessDeniedException","operation":"GetKnowledgeBase"}} [403]
  GET /api/memory/sessions?actor_id=does-not-exist
  {"code":"aws.not_found","message":"Actor does-not-exist not found","detail":{"aws_error_code":"ResourceNotFoundException","operation":"ListSessions"}} [404]
  ```
  The host's :8000 was not touched (it still answers 500 for both, as the brief recorded).
- ✅ Console: five `apiErrors.aws.*` keys in en + zh-CN; `i18n_check` passes; screenshots `kb-detail_{en,zh-CN}.png`, `registry-edit_{en,zh-CN}.png`, `memory-short-term_{en,zh-CN}.png` under `/home/ubuntu/workspace/agentcore_launchpad/.claude/self-evolution/runs/SE-005/`, extracted text in `shots-text.json`. En KB detail reads "AWS denied access to this resource — …", Registry edit "Failed to load record: AWS rejected the request as invalid — …", Memory toast "Memory lookup failed: The AWS resource was not found — …"; zh-CN equivalents render too.
- ✅ `docs/api.md` + `.zh-CN` list the `aws.*` codes; `docs/architecture.md` + `.zh-CN` gained the error-envelope section.
- ✅ `make verify` passes (tail above).
- ✅ New behaviour covered hermetically (`test_errors_aws.py`, `test_memory_console.py`); the gate needs no AWS.
- ✅ Architecture and API docs updated, with zh-CN twins.

## 4. Not done / deviations

- The Memory toast fix required a small change outside `errors.py`: the memory and chat `memory.unavailable` wrappers now let a *mapped* `ClientError` propagate. Without that the wrapper would keep swallowing it into 502 boto text. Unmapped failures (endpoint errors, `InternalServerException`) still get `memory.unavailable` 502, and the existing test was adjusted to use such a code.
- Two existing tests encoded the old "AccessDeniedException stays a 500/502" behaviour; both were updated to the new contract rather than deleted.
- `ruff format` is not part of the gate and reformats unrelated code in `chat.py`/`memory.py`; I reverted that and applied only the minimal hunks.
- One pre-existing eslint warning in `EvaluationExperiment.tsx` (exhaustive-deps) is untouched.
- No `/v1`-specific test was added; `/v1` shares the handlers and `docs/api.md` states so. Existing `/v1` tests pass within `make verify`.
